upload_intro: Files travel as Base64 in the JSON body or as `multipart/form-data`: one part per file, named after its field, the other values as JSON in the part `values`. Uploaded files belong to that run only.
agent_git:
`orkexa` is not on PyPI; it is installed from its public GitHub repository at the exact commit Nodestro
used (see `pyproject.toml`), so installing needs access to github.com. No account or token is needed. Export
again with "include the library" if the project has to install without access to github.com.
agent_bundle:
`orkexa` is included as source code in `vendor/orkexa` (proprietary Levuvo license, see its `LICENSE`) and
installed from there; no access to its repository is needed. The person who exported this project
confirmed that they may pass the library on. Keep that in mind before sharing the project.
aws_region: The AWS region for {label}; without it the exported region{shown}.
aws_signin: AWS sign-in through the default credential chain of this machine (environment, `~/.aws`, IAM role); the project contains no AWS credentials.
key: The key for {label}. Without it, starting a run answers 503.
endpoint_key: A key for {label}, if the server needs one.
connection_secret: Secret of the service connection {connection} ({type}); its settings go into `DATA_DIR/secrets/connections.json` ({configure}).
connection_configure: or with `configure` in a portable package
portable.local_models_line: , the local models ({models}) with the model server Ollama
portable.models_check: and, once, every model file by SHA-256 (this can take a few minutes)
portable.ui_off: ; this package has no web interface, other programs use it through the API
portable.providers_none: This application uses no AI provider that needs a key: nothing to enter.
portable.providers_intro: This application uses these AI providers. Each needs its key (or address) on the computer it runs on:
portable.models_none: This application uses no local model.
portable.models_intro: The package contains these models and the model server Ollama {version}. It starts and stops with the application, listens on `127.0.0.1` only and needs no configuration:
portable.models_head:
| Model | Used as | Size | Memory (about) | License |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
portable.models_total: Together: {total} on disk. The memory column is the estimate for a moderate context ({context} tokens; `[models] context_length`). Without a graphics card the models run on the processor: that works, but an answer can take a minute or more.
portable.models_external: This workflow uses local models that are not in this package: {models}. Run Ollama on this computer with these models and set `OLLAMA_BASE_URL` (for example `http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1`).
portable.network_offline: This package was checked for offline operation before the export: it needs **no internet connection**. The model server gets no proxy and downloads nothing (`[models] offline = true`).
portable.network_none: This workflow needs no internet connection.
portable.network_intro: This workflow needs a network connection for:
portable.need.endpoint: the model `{name}` of an OpenAI-compatible server ({detail})
portable.need.docker_sandbox: the AI-generated tool `{name}` (runs only in Docker; Docker must be installed)
portable.output_on: A copy of every result file goes to `{folder}` (a folder per run: `<date>_<time>_<run>`). A folder that cannot be created or written falls back to `results` in this folder; the start window and the Settings page say so.
portable.output_off: Result files are not copied to a folder (`[data] output_dir` is empty).
